title: Million Dollar Claude Business Hack to start a company #ai #claude #business
description:
Resume writing is a $400M industry and most of it is bad. People pay $200 to $500 for a basic resume and $500 to $1,000+ for executive-level work, and the output is usually generic, bloated, and ignored by both ATS systems and hiring managers.

This tip shows the exact Claude workflow to run a premium resume and LinkedIn service:

Rewrite any resume using the XYZ formula (accomplished X as measured by Y by doing Z), keyword-match it to a specific job description, overhaul the LinkedIn headline, About, and Experience sections, and generate a structured cover letter. Then go deeper: gap analysis against the target role, behavioral interview prep with STAR answers, outreach sequences to hiring managers, and a salary negotiation script.

Pricing model in the video:
$300 resume-only
$750 resume + LinkedIn + cover letter
$2,000 full career accelerator
Two accelerator clients and five resume clients a week clears $5,500/week.
